entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's garbage and your return policy is a joke. I want my money back, now.

I can certainly look into that for you, and I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I don't have time for a 20-question interrogation! I don't want it. I missed the window because I had a medical emergency and ended up in the hospital. I'm not paying for something I couldn't return because I was getting prepped for surgery. This is unacceptable. Get me your manager.

I understand your frustration, sir, and a manager won't be necessary. I can handle this for you. I'm very sorry to hear about your medical situation. Can I get your order number so I can pull up your account?
Fine. It's VF8675309. It's been a nightmare. On top of everything else, my son's overseas deployment got moved up, so he couldn't even help me sort this out. The whole thing is a mess.
Thank you for that information, and for your son's service. Please give me just one moment to review your order details... Okay, I see the order here. You received it 39 days ago.
See! That's what I'm talking about! Some ridiculous 10 or 20 day window. You people are crooks! I'm going to light you up on every review site on the internet.

Sir, I apologize for any misunderstanding. I'm looking at our return policy right now, and it states that all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 39, you are unfortunately outside the window for a full refund.
Wait, what? Ninety days? Are you sure?
Yes, absolutely. I can start that return process for you right now. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label. Once we receive the item back, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's... surprisingly easy. Thank you. I appreciate you actually helping me.
You're very welcome, sir. It's my pleasure to get this sorted out for you. The email with the label is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you, Diana.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a much better rest of your day.
